key_area_parameters.spatial_decision: Preserve rail-industrial edges, insert small test yards, open ground-floor labs to public review windows.
key_area_parameters.frontage_rule: Every experimental frontage must provide a non-digital bypass and visible human steward.

key_area_parameters.spatial_decision: Use a diagonal public hall to connect campus, community, start-up interface, and railway memory.
key_area_parameters.frontage_rule: Ground-floor public interface must support free passage even when events or AI tests are closed.

key_area_parameters.spatial_decision: Create a station-city civic plaza where international exchange, daily service, and demonstrator projects share one public ground.
key_area_parameters.frontage_rule: High-intensity demonstration uses are allowed only when daily public services keep priority at ground level.
